text: In 2047 the rescue ship Lewis and Clark answers a distress call from the Event Horizon, a vessel that vanished seven years ago and has reappeared in orbit around Neptune. Its designer, Dr. Weir, joins Captain Miller's crew aboard, where they find signs of a massacre and soon find themselves [stranded on the derelict|rules|trapped with no way out]. Each of them begins to see [the people they failed and the losses they carry|wrong|loss that won't heal]. A garbled Latin plea in the signal suggests the experimental drive [opened a door beyond the known universe|threat|evil places] and [brought something back|origin|from another world].
